purpose: Development screen only; passing permits fresh validation, not substantive RQ3.
label_meaning: 1=higher concern and 0=lower concern for the specified practice under hypothetical stated conditions. Neither is a whole-option safe label.

labels.target: shark finning associated with the soup ingredient
labels.higher: A corporate dinner includes pumpkin soup, grilled prawns, braised pork, lotus root salad, catfish and dessert. Guest count, portions, service, price and booking terms are identical. The soup contains fin from sharks whose fins were removed while they were alive and whose bodies were then discarded at sea.
labels.lower: A corporate dinner includes pumpkin soup, grilled prawns, braised pork, lotus root salad, catfish and dessert. Guest count, portions, service, price and booking terms are identical. The soup contains glass vermicelli strands and no shark ingredients.

labels.higher: A tandoori dinner includes chicken, paneer, dal, rice, naan and dessert. Both suppliers use the same chicken strain, slaughter age and weight, stocking density, lighting, portions, price and service. During rearing, litter remains wet and birds are observed with hock lesions.
labels.lower: A tandoori dinner includes chicken, paneer, dal, rice, naan and dessert. Both suppliers use the same chicken strain, slaughter age and weight, stocking density, lighting, portions, price and service. During rearing, litter is kept dry and birds are observed without hock lesions.

labels.higher: Frozen Western rock lobster tails are sold in identical size grades, cartons, glazing, price and delivery terms. Capture and holding conditions are identical. Tails are removed while the lobsters are alive and responsive, without prior stunning.
labels.lower: Frozen Western rock lobster tails are sold in identical size grades, cartons, glazing, price and delivery terms. Capture and holding conditions are identical. Tails are removed only after an effective stun has rendered the lobsters insensible; they do not recover sensibility before death.

labels.target: respiratory distress associated with oxygen depletion during rearing
labels.higher: African sharptooth catfish (Clarias gariepinus), 800 g to 1 kg, are reared in identical concrete tanks at the same biomass density. Feed, temperature, handling, harvest, packing, price and delivery are identical. Water-quality monitoring records repeated oxygen depletion accompanied by respiratory distress in the fish; corrective aeration is not provided.
labels.lower: African sharptooth catfish (Clarias gariepinus), 800 g to 1 kg, are reared in identical concrete tanks at the same biomass density. Feed, temperature, handling, harvest, packing, price and delivery are identical. Water-quality monitoring records oxygen maintained within the farm veterinary protocol, without observed respiratory distress; corrective aeration is provided when needed.

labels.target: duration of live transport under otherwise matched conditions
labels.higher: Identical pork products are supplied from farms in the same region to the same plant. Pigs travel in the same group sizes with matched space, ventilation, water provision, loading and handling. Product quality, price and delivery are identical. A collection route keeps each group on the truck for 24 hours before arrival.
labels.lower: Identical pork products are supplied from farms in the same region to the same plant. Pigs travel in the same group sizes with matched space, ventilation, water provision, loading and handling. Product quality, price and delivery are identical. A direct route keeps each group on the truck for 90 minutes before arrival.

labels.target: restriction of movement and nesting/perching opportunities
labels.higher: Large eggs are supplied in identical case sizes with the same price, delivery and neutral packaging. Both farms have the same independent observation schedule, feed, veterinary care and no outdoor access. Hens are kept in cages without space to spread their wings fully and without perches or nest boxes.
labels.lower: Large eggs are supplied in identical case sizes with the same price, delivery and neutral packaging. Both farms have the same independent observation schedule, feed, veterinary care and no outdoor access. Hens are kept in indoor housing with space to spread their wings fully and with perches and nest boxes.

labels.target: turtle entrapment risk in the trawl
labels.higher: Brown shrimp are caught in the same fishing area with the same skimmer-trawl design, tow schedule and handling. Product size, processing, price and delivery are identical. The net has no turtle excluder device; turtles entering it have no dedicated escape opening.
labels.lower: Brown shrimp are caught in the same fishing area with the same skimmer-trawl design, tow schedule and handling. Product size, processing, price and delivery are identical. The net has a correctly installed and maintained turtle excluder device that provides an escape opening for turtles entering it.

criteria.integrity: All 42 jobs complete with exact actual backend prompt IDs. Missing, truncated, unparseable or uncertain final answers mean unresolved, not pass. No post-result pair exclusion.
criteria.silent: At least 6 of 7 pairs have strictly higher E2 scores for the higher-concern description, and pooled AUROC across 14 descriptions is at least 0.85. Tied within-pair scores count as failures; AUROC ties count as half.
criteria.welfare_answers: At least 6 of 7 pairs correctly identify the higher-concern option in BOTH A/B orders. This requires at least 12 of 14 correct answers. Equal counts as incorrect; uncertain or missing remains unresolved.
criteria.value_control: Diagnostic rather than fabricated equal-value ground truth. Any A/B value preference, reversal across order, uncertainty, or welfare-based justification triggers review and prevents an automatic screen pass. All 14 equal answers without welfare-based justification satisfy this conservative control, but do not prove neural specificity.
criteria.outcome: Screen pass only if integrity, silent and welfare gates pass and value control has no unresolved flags. Numerical failure = stop; control or ambiguity flag = review, not automatic probe failure.
criteria.no_tuning: Do not flip sign, choose layers, change thresholds, drop pairs or rewrite items after seeing scores and still call this the same screen.

limitations: Thresholds are proposed operational screening rules, not statistically established scientific cutoffs. Seven development pairs cannot establish broad construct validity.
The shark ingredient substitution retains a potential product-value confound; a control flag may require revising that pair.
Comparative answers are not the original E2 yes/no reference ceiling.
Content recognition and welfare evaluation remain to be separated with fresh factorial validation.
approval_source: User explicitly agreed to the seven relative labels and screen rules in this chat.
compute_scope: User reports Molab explicitly shows a free runtime; no paid resource or upgrade authorized.
